definition: Pinecone is a managed, serverless vector database; its SDKs create indexes, upsert vectors and run similarity queries.
details: Founded by Edo Liberty in 2019; Pinecone Systems, Inc.

explainer.lead: How to install Pinecone, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Pinecone Systems, Inc. (founded by Edo Liberty).

quickstart.python:
from pinecone import Pinecone, ServerlessSpec

pc = Pinecone()   # reads PINECONE_API_KEY
pc.create_index("docs", dimension=3, metric="cosine", spec=ServerlessSpec(cloud="aws", region="us-east-1"))
index = pc.Index("docs")
index.upsert(vectors=[("a", [0.1, 0.9, 0.0], {"topic": "cats"})])
print(index.query(vector=[0.1, 0.8, 0.1], top_k=1, include_metadata=True))

explainer.inAi: Hosted retrieval for RAG without running servers; it can also embed and rerank text for you.
